bayts.text: I have thanked You, O Allah, with ink, O Giver of help and love.
I have thanked You, O Allah, with pens, O Giver of the most excellent speech.
I have thanked You, O Allah, with prayer, O Effacer of the hardship of the haters.
I have thanked You, O Allah, with fasting, O You Who protected me from widowhood.
I have thanked You, O Allah, with vigil, O Witness for me today of the fast.
I have thanked You, O Allah, with movement, O Giver of what puts the battlefield to shame.
I have thanked You, O Allah, with stillness, O Sender-down Who bestowed calm on me.
To You be my gratitude for the days, O Possessor of opposition (to enemies) and of vigil.
To You be my gratitude for every year, O You Who are exalted above sleep and slumber.
To You be my gratitude without end, O You toward Whom my journey has its end.
O our Lord, bless with an immense blessing him through whom my whole being has grown.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And raise my striving through him with an ascending gratitude, O Raiser Who never ceases to be Everlasting.
And gather my letters and bless them, toward You, the manifest and the hidden.
You made my heart clear, setting right and directing; through You (You made clear) my tongue; You led succour to me.
You have led my limbs to righteous deeds, completing my hopes.
My heart intends good, and the tongue: toward it tend the remembrances and fair things.
You have not forgotten me, Lord, nor do I forget You, and You have not turned toward me whoever forgets You.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O You Who are named Beautiful (Al-Jamīl) and Appreciative (Ash-Shakūr),
bless with a blessing and a peace without end, upon him who was carried by night to the Boundary (Qurʾān 17:1; 53:14).
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make the letters of this prelude accepted, thankfully received, venerated.
And in the heart of the Chosen and in the hearts of his Companions make me a joy possessed of wealth.
O Enricher, O Gatherer (Al-Jāmiʿ): You have enriched with what You gathered for me, as You have satisfied.
Bless with a blessing that gathers good things, putting the "Dalāʾil al-Khayrāt" to shame.
upon him who led to me, on Friday, what was chosen for me, as a wish, and gathered it.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make through him the months and the days witnesses for me; protect me from widowhood.
O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Beloved!
Grant me soundness and grant me well-being and protection, and make my letters healing.
And make my recitation and my writing the dearest, among acts of worship, to You, O Beloved.
And protect me from Your stratagem, O All-Knowing, and protect me from delusion, O Forbearing.
And protect me from evil decree forever, O Best Worshipped One, Who has been worshipped with love.
Your love for me has already removed corruption toward other than my person, and repelled the envious
toward others than me and toward other than what a Generous One chose for me, Whose love has already been decreed.
O our Lord, O Lord of lands and servants, O You Who disgraced whoever sought my harm and destroyed him.
O our Lord, O Lord of the lands and the heaven, O Everlasting Who have already traced my happiness.
O our Lord, O Creator of the two Abodes, O You Who protected me from the two disgraces.
O our Lord, O You Who banish the enemies toward a direction other than mine, protecting from sickness.
O our Lord, O You to Whom belong dominion together with praise, O You Who gathered my wishes for me.
Bless with a blessing that banishes Satan toward other than what You chose for me as homelands,
with a peace that makes the Accursed despair of me and of harming my family, O Helper,
upon the Prophet and Messenger Aḥmad, he whose mission to creation has been praised.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And with my writing gladden Your host, that is, abiding righteous (deeds) with You.
O Sender-down Who made my homelands good for me, O Protector from the wiles of Satan.
Bless with a blessing that draws succour to me, with a peace that perpetuates the count,
upon the Hāshimite Prophet, the banner, he whose like has not been known among creation.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And bear witness for me forever that I am well pleased with Him Who protected my body from my illnesses.
And bear witness for me forever that You are dearer to me than any other, and the Prophet, after, the dearest.
You granted me sincerity in affirming Oneness, establishing the mission of the Unique (Prophet).
You granted me, in what has passed of my time, what perpetuates my glad tidings and my safety.
Your host accompanied me in the time of striving, and they removed the enemies toward others than me with diligence.
You have removed Iblīs and whoever follows him toward a direction other than mine: for You are God.
There have not made for me envious ones or unbelievers, nor hypocrites or (perils of) journeys.
Hopes come to me from You forever, and from Your Prophet, the Messenger Aḥmad.
So bless forever, greeting with peace, upon him, in the Family and the Companions, and increase his loftiness through me.
Increase for the Prophet what gladdens him and what benefits him in me, and grant me what is most upright.
Grant the Prophet, beginning and seal, the most abiding glad tidings, without closing.
